definitions.gloss: copy paper; photocopy paper; printer paper
definitions.explanation: standard white paper used for photocopying and printing

examples.english: I ordered one box of A4 copy paper.

notes:
コピー{用紙|ようし} is standard white paper used in photocopiers and printers. An everyday office and school supply.

COMMON SIZES IN JAPAN:
- A4 (210×297mm): most common office standard
- B5 (182×257mm): common in schools (Japan uses the JIS B-series)
- A3 (297×420mm): for larger documents and posters

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- コピー{用紙|ようし}が{切|き}れた: ran out of copy paper
- コピー{用紙|ようし}を{補充|ほじゅう}する: to refill/restock paper
- コピー{用紙|ようし}をセットする: to load paper (into a printer)

RELATED TERMS:
- {上質紙|じょうしつし}: high-quality paper
- {再生紙|さいせいし}: recycled paper
- {裏紙|うらがみ}: scrap paper (reusing the blank back side of printed paper)
